mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the head and spine to the trunk was most worthwhile because it showed nerves and blood both reaching the same muscles.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the eye and ears was clear but fairly predictable: both already had named places in the head.

surprise.text: The joined trunk made it clearer that the food pipe, nerves and blood vessels cross between regions by separate routes.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though the final joins were the only offered actions, so they felt more like assembly than decisions.

continue.text: Probably not right away. The final cutaway was a satisfying ending, but the last few steps were predictable and offered little choice.
